title: Catchplate fixed native bootstrap acquisition client v1
description: Closed configuration original, at most 16384 bytes. Runtime retains independently pinned originals, verifies real native startup evidence before private-key loading/network, then makes one fixed bootstrap POST on a full TLS1.3 connection. Explicit challenge is independently pinned before delegation/setup issuance, never generated or learned from a response. Schema shape is not pin provenance, native verification, installation permission or enrollment completion.

endpoint.description: Canonical literal unicast SocketAddr with nonzero port. Runtime rejects unspecified/multicast/broadcast and scoped IPv6 including mapped IPv4 exclusions; private and loopback addresses remain permitted. This is not DNS or a URL.

startupEvidence.description: Pinned genuine native startup evidence original, at most 65536 bytes; not standard host-manifest or trust-publication diagnostics.

startupExpectations.description: Independent native startup expectations, at most 16384 bytes.

sessionScope.description: Independent nonce-free catchplate.nativeIngressSessionScope/v1 original, at most 16384 bytes. Complete scope must agree with startup expectations; explicit client challenge must differ from startup nonce.

trustRoots.description: Independent Nitro attestation roots original, at most 1048576 bytes; not the caller issuer.

clientCertificate.description: Existing bootstrap CALLER certificate chain canonical PEM, at most 65536 bytes and 1..8 certificates of at most 16384 DER bytes each. The actual TLS-selected chain must equal this retained original. No target certificate is required.

clientPrivateKey.description: Existing caller key canonical PKCS8 PEM, at most 16384 bytes. Runtime requires owner-only single-link regular file owned by root or effective caller before reading bytes. No target key, arbitrary key export or hardware-custody claim.

callerIssuer.description: Independently pinned single canonical issuer PEM, at most 65536 bytes/16384 DER bytes. Genuine receiver checks exact native quoted root membership and actual caller chain under this selected issuer.

delegationAuthorizer.description: Independent dedicated delegation Ed25519 public PEM, at most 16384 bytes; its artifact pin is retained as the expected root pin.

setupAuthorizer.description: Separate independent setup Ed25519 public PEM, at most 16384 bytes. Not selected by evidence or learned from another root.

request.description: Pinned exact catchplate.nativeEnrollmentBootstrapRequest/v1 original, canonical ASCII JSON plus one LF, at most 196608 bytes. Contains exact signed delegation/setup and target request originals bounded 32768/32768/65536 bytes. These same bytes are POSTed without rewriting; receiver compares all three component originals.

clientChallengeBase64url.description: Independent preselected nonzero raw32 challenge encoded canonical unpadded base64url. Must already be bound by signed delegation; no local RNG replacement or retry renewal.

expectedTargetPrincipal.description: Independent exact target identity, nonempty UTF-8 of at most 1024 bytes; runtime enforces the byte bound and genuine target request profile.

path.description: Exact absolute path without traversal, repeated/trailing separators or symlinks. Runtime enforces canonical path spelling, 4096-byte limit and anchored no-follow opens, then retains/rechecks held and named file identity plus original bytes.
